editorialSummary.heading: Planning around the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar
highlights: August 10 first day and May 21 last day
Five staff days with no students during the school year
Six report-card dates listed on the district calendar
paragraphs: Students on the Traditional Calendar start Monday, August 10, 2026, and finish Friday, May 21, 2027. Students are out October 8-12: October 8 is a staff day, October 9 is fall break and October 12 is Indigenous Peoples' Day. Classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

Thanksgiving break is November 23-27. Winter break ends January 1, but students return Tuesday, January 5 because January 4 is a staff day. Spring break is March 15-19. Students are also out for Good Friday on March 26 and a staff day on March 29.

The Traditional Calendar uses six-week grading periods and lists report-card dates on September 25, November 6, January 13, February 19, April 16 and June 4. The PDF also shows state testing windows; families should use campus instructions for the dates that apply to each student's grade and courses.

faqs.question: When is the first day on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Students following the Traditional Calendar start Monday, August 10, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: The last student day on Fort Worth ISD's Traditional Calendar is Friday, May 21, 2027. ADSY and Intersessional campuses continue beyond that date.

faqs.question: Which Fort Worth ISD calendar should my school use?
faqs.answer: Most campuses use the Traditional Calendar. Participating ELEVATE campuses use ADSY, three early-college campuses use ECHS at TCC, and Alice Carlson and Jo Kelly use the Intersessional Calendar. Families should confirm the calendar assigned to their campus.

faqs.question: When is fall break on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Friday, October 9. Students are also off for a staff day October 8 and Indigenous Peoples' Day October 12, so classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: When is Fort Worth ISD Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a staff day with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is Fort Worth ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Which staff days have no students on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: During the student year, the Traditional Calendar lists September 21, October 8, January 4, February 15 and March 29 as staff days with no students.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Traditional Calendar students do not attend Monday, February 15, 2027. The calendar labels it a staff day rather than a district holiday; ECHS at TCC follows a different schedule.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Traditional Calendar students do not attend Friday, March 26, 2027. The following Monday is a staff day with no students, and classes resume March 30; ECHS at TCC follows a different schedule.

faqs.question: When are report cards scheduled on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?

faqs.question: Are there any districtwide early-release days on the Fort Worth ISD Traditional Calendar?

editorialSummary.heading: How the Fort Worth ISD ADSY Calendar works
highlights: The Traditional Calendar schedule through May 21
Twenty-five additional instruction days from May 24 through June 29
Memorial Day and observed Juneteenth remain no-school dates
paragraphs: ADSY students start Monday, August 10, 2026, and follow the Traditional Calendar through Friday, May 21, 2027. That includes the October no-class stretch, Thanksgiving week, winter break and spring break. Five staff days during the regular year have no student attendance.

The additional schedule begins Monday, May 24. ADSY classes meet May 24-28; June 1-4, 7-11, 14-17 and 21-25; and June 28-29. Memorial Day on May 31 and observed Juneteenth on June 18 remain district holidays, which is why the 25 days are split into six separate ranges.

Fort Worth ISD says ADSY supports acceleration, small-group instruction and enrichment at participating ELEVATE campuses. Five FOCUS elementary schools in the ELEVATE region use the Traditional Calendar instead, so families should verify the calendar assigned to their campus.

Five named FOCUS elementary schools remain on the Traditional Calendar even though they are in the ELEVATE region.

faqs.question: What does ADSY mean in Fort Worth ISD?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year. Fort Worth ISD adds 25 instructional days for participating ELEVATE campuses to provide acceleration, small-group support and enrichment.

faqs.question: How is the Fort Worth ISD ADSY Calendar different from the Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: ADSY campuses follow the Traditional Calendar through May 21, then add 25 school days from May 24 through June 29. Memorial Day on May 31 and observed Juneteenth on June 18 are no-school days.

faqs.question: What is ELEVATE in Fort Worth ISD?
faqs.answer: ELEVATE is Fort Worth ISD's network of campuses receiving additional staffing, coaching and leadership support. Participating ELEVATE campuses use ADSY except for the five FOCUS elementary schools assigned to the Traditional Calendar.

faqs.question: Which Fort Worth ISD schools use the ADSY Calendar?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists Harlean Beal, George C. Clarke, Clifford Davis, Diamond Hill, East Handley, Eastern Hills-West Handley, W.M. Green, Rufino Mendoza, Hazel Harvey Peace, T.A. Sims, W.J. Turner, Van Zandt-Guinn, Maudrie M. Walton, Westcreek and Western Hills elementary schools, plus William James, William Monnig, Morningside and Wedgwood middle schools.

faqs.question: When does the Fort Worth ISD ADSY year start?
faqs.answer: ADSY students begin the regular school year Monday, August 10, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day for Fort Worth ISD ADSY students?
faqs.answer: The regular semester ends May 21, but participating ADSY students continue through Tuesday, June 29, 2027.

faqs.question: What are the 25 additional ADSY dates?
faqs.answer: The added instruction days are May 24-28; June 1-4, 7-11, 14-17 and 21-25; and June 28-29. These ranges total 25 weekdays.

faqs.question: Do ADSY students attend school on Memorial Day?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, May 31, 2027, is a district holiday with no staff or students. ADSY classes resume June 1.

faqs.question: Do ADSY students attend on Juneteenth?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, June 18 is the district's observed Juneteenth holiday. The next ADSY session begins Monday, June 21.

faqs.question: Which ELEVATE schools stay on the Traditional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Fort Worth ISD says Carter Park, D. McRae, David K. Sellars, Sunrise-McMillan and Woodway are FOCUS elementary schools in the ELEVATE region but use the Traditional Calendar instead of ADSY.

faqs.question: When is fall break on the ADSY Calendar?
faqs.answer: Fall break is October 9. Students are also off October 8 for a staff day and October 12 for Indigenous Peoples' Day, returning October 13.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for ADSY schools?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026. Classes resume November 30.

faqs.question: When do ADSY students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Winter break ends January 1, and January 4 is a staff day with no students. Classes resume Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

faqs.question: When is spring break on the ADSY Calendar?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 15-19, 2027. Students return March 22.

faqs.question: Which staff days have no ADSY students?
faqs.answer: During the student year, the calendar lists September 21, October 8, January 4, February 15 and March 29 as staff days with no students.

faqs.question: When are ADSY report cards scheduled?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists report-card dates on September 25, November 6, January 13, February 19, April 16 and June 4.

faqs.question: Which Fort Worth ISD schools use the ECHS at TCC Calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar applies to Marine Creek Collegiate at TCC Northwest, TCC South/FWISD Collegiate High School at TCC South, and the Texas Academy of Biomedical Sciences at TCC Trinity River.

faqs.question: When is the first day for Fort Worth ISD ECHS students?
faqs.answer: Fort Worth ISD students following the ECHS at TCC Calendar begin the fall semester Monday, August 10, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day on the ECHS Calendar?
faqs.answer: The final student day on the ECHS at TCC Calendar is Friday, May 21, 2027.

faqs.question: When is ECHS Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23-27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: How long is winter break for FWISD ECHS students?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 6, 2027. Five staff days follow before students return.

faqs.question: When do ECHS students return for the spring semester?
faqs.answer: Students return Thursday, January 14, 2027. January 7-8 and January 11-13 are staff days with no students.

faqs.question: When is spring break on the ECHS Calendar?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 15-19, 2027. Classes resume March 22.

faqs.question: Does the ECHS Calendar have an October fall break?
faqs.answer: No October fall break is listed on the ECHS PDF. October 8, 9 and 12 are shown as regular calendar days rather than district holidays or staff days.

faqs.question: Is February 15 a no-school day for ECHS students?
faqs.answer: The ECHS PDF does not label February 15 as a holiday or staff day. Families should follow the ECHS calendar rather than assuming the Traditional Calendar applies.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a holiday on the ECHS Calendar?
faqs.answer: The ECHS PDF does not mark March 26 as a district holiday. Check the campus calendar for any college-course or campus-specific schedule.

faqs.question: Which ECHS staff days have no students?
faqs.answer: During the academic year, January 7-8 and January 11-13 are staff days with no students. Staff preparation days before August 10 are not included in this student calendar.

faqs.question: When are ECHS report cards scheduled?
faqs.answer: The ECHS calendar lists September 25, November 6, January 13, February 19, April 16 and June 4 as report-card dates.

faqs.question: How are ECHS grading periods organized?
faqs.answer: The calendar uses six six-week grading periods. The spring grading periods begin January 14, February 15 and April 12.

faqs.question: Do TCC academic dates replace the Fort Worth ISD ECHS Calendar?
faqs.answer: No. This PDF provides FWISD's districtwide ECHS attendance dates, while college-course meetings and TCC deadlines may follow separate schedules. Families should check both when a date matters.

faqs.question: Does the ECHS PDF list state testing windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. It lists STAAR EOC, TELPAS, STAAR Alternate 2 and STAAR windows. Individual participation depends on the student's grade and courses.

hero.mobileDescription: Alice Carlson and Jo Kelly students start Aug. 10 and finish June 7. Regular classes do not meet during the Oct. 13-19 and Mar. 8-12 intersession periods.
hero.desktopDescription: This calendar is for Alice Carlson Applied Learning Center and Jo Kelly School. Students start Aug. 10, 2026, and finish June 7, 2027. Regular classes do not meet during fall intersession Oct. 13-19 or spring intersession Mar. 8-12; spring break follows Mar. 15-19.

editorialSummary.heading: Planning with the Fort Worth ISD Intersessional Calendar
highlights: Two intersession periods in October and March
paragraphs: Alice Carlson Applied Learning Center and Jo Kelly School use the Intersessional Calendar. Students begin August 10. They are out October 8-12 for a staff day and fall holidays, then regular classes do not meet during fall intersession October 13-19. Regular classes resume October 20.

Winter break runs December 21-January 1, and students return January 5 after the January 4 staff day. Spring intersession is March 8-12, immediately before spring break March 15-19. Regular classes resume March 22.

The calendar uses four nine-week grading periods. Standards-based report dates apply to Alice Carlson; Jo Kelly students do not participate in the report-card or state-testing entries printed on the calendar. Fort Worth ISD's online calendar and printable PDF disagree on the first report date, so families should confirm that date with Alice Carlson.

highlights.note: The district's online calendar says no staff or students, while noting that some campus staff work.

highlights.note: Spring break follows immediately on March 15-19.

highlights.label: Last student day
highlights.note: The school year ends on Monday.

comparativeInsights: The Intersessional Calendar starts with the Traditional Calendar but continues 17 calendar days beyond the Traditional May 21 last day.
Regular classes do not meet during the October 13-19 and March 8-12 intersession periods.
Spring intersession and spring break create two back-to-back weeks without regular instruction.
The calendar uses four nine-week grading periods instead of the six six-week periods on the Traditional, ADSY and ECHS calendars.
Jo Kelly students do not participate in the state testing or standards-based report entries printed on the calendar.

faqs.question: Which schools use the Fort Worth ISD Intersessional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Alice Carlson Applied Learning Center and Jo Kelly School use the 2026-2027 Intersessional Calendar.

faqs.question: When is the first day on the Intersessional Calendar?
faqs.answer: Students at Alice Carlson Applied Learning Center and Jo Kelly School start Monday, August 10, 2026.

faqs.question: When is the last day on the Intersessional Calendar?
faqs.answer: The final student day on the Intersessional Calendar is Monday, June 7, 2027, which is also the end of the fourth nine-week grading period.

faqs.question: When are the Fort Worth ISD intersession dates?
faqs.answer: Fall intersession runs October 13-19, 2026. Spring intersession runs March 8-12, 2027.

faqs.question: Do students attend school during Fort Worth ISD intersession?
faqs.answer: Regular classes do not meet during October 13-19 or March 8-12. The district labels fall intersession as no staff or students, with some staff working at Alice Carlson and Jo Kelly. Check Alice Carlson or Jo Kelly for any campus-specific intersession programming or services.

faqs.question: When do regular classes resume after fall intersession?
faqs.answer: Regular classes resume Tuesday, October 20, 2026. The sequence begins with an October 8 staff day, followed by two district holidays and the October 13-19 intersession.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for intersessional campuses?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs November 23-27, 2026. Students return November 30.

faqs.question: When do students on the Fort Worth ISD Intersessional Calendar return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Winter break ends January 1, 2027. January 4 is a staff day with no students, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: How do spring intersession and spring break fit together?
faqs.answer: Spring intersession is March 8-12, and spring break follows March 15-19. Regular classes resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is there school on Good Friday or March 29 on the Fort Worth ISD Intersessional Calendar?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday on March 26 is a district holiday, and March 29 is a staff day with no students. Classes resume March 30.

faqs.question: Which staff days have no students on the Fort Worth ISD Intersessional Calendar?
faqs.answer: During the student year, September 21, October 8, January 4, February 15 and March 29 are staff days with no students.

faqs.question: Is there school on Memorial Day for intersessional campuses?
faqs.answer: No. Memorial Day on Monday, May 31, 2027, is a district holiday. Students return June 1 for the final week.

faqs.question: How many grading periods are on the Intersessional Calendar?
faqs.answer: There are four nine-week grading periods ending October 7, January 15, April 2 and June 7.

faqs.question: When are standards-based reports scheduled for Alice Carlson?
faqs.answer: January 28, April 15 and June 17 are confirmed. The first date is unresolved: the current online calendar shows October 23, while the printable PDF shows October 29. The PDF states that Jo Kelly students do not participate in report cards.

faqs.question: Do Jo Kelly students take the state tests listed on the PDF?
faqs.answer: The calendar specifically notes that Jo Kelly students do not participate in the printed state-testing schedule. Families should follow school guidance for any student-specific assessment.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: The printable PDF labels October 12 Indigenous Peoples' Day, while the current online calendar labels it Fall Break. The date and no-school status agree; this record retains the PDF event name.
